premise.claim: "Bumps github.com/klauspost/compress from 1.17.11 to 1.18.7" — upstream releases in that range carry security/correctness fixes (s2.NewDict OOB read v1.18.7; s2 amd64 stack frame corruption v1.18.6; zstd crash on dictionary change with same ID and full-zero-frames default v1.18.5; downstream CVE-2025-61728 v1.18.3) that the vendored v1.17.11 lacks.
premise.evidence: results/premise-p0.txt — base vendors v1.17.11 (no dict-same-ID fix, no fullZero default); head vendors v1.18.7 with both. Scope nuance: s2/gzhttp/flate are NOT in fluid's compiled package set at base or head, so the s2 security fixes do not change fluid binaries; the compiled delta is zstd/fse/huff0, reached only via promhttp metrics compression (which uses no dictionaries).
